slides.headline: 73.3 years: how long the world now lives

slides.body: The UN estimates global **life expectancy at birth** reached [[73.3 years]] in 2024.
That is **8.4 years more** than in 1995. The world gained [[almost a decade]] of life in a single generation, even after the COVID-19 dip.
The UN projects it will reach [[77.4 years]] by **2054**. That would be another 4.1 years.
If you got 4 more years, what would you do with them? Tell us below.
